videos.overview: Paco and Brayan are depressed by the breakup of their relationship, but with the help of Borrego, they will try to recover them. See, if with your advice they will achieve the forgiveness of their ex-partners.

videos.title: Tatuados sin gloria
videos.overview: Paco wants to remove Simone's tattoo and finds a group that can help him, right there he meets Mila who he will try to flirt with. See if she can convince him to keep his tattoo or take it off forever.

videos.title: La convención
videos.overview: Toña enrolls in the convention of domestic workers and must give a home to a foreign worker. After meeting Magaly, will Paco and Borrego respect Toña's rights?
